title: BREAKING: Remove email field from User response schema
description: Removes the required 'email' property from the User schema. Consumers that read user.email for notifications, receipts, or account verification will break.

title: BREAKING: Add required X-Auth-Token header to GET /api/v2/users/{id}
description: Adds a required authentication header to the user lookup endpoint. All consumers calling this endpoint without the header will receive 401 responses.

title: BREAKING: Migrate all endpoints from /api/v2/ to /api/v3/
description: Renames all API paths from /api/v2/users to /api/v3/users without providing a backward-compatible redirect. All consumers registered on v2 endpoints will receive 404.

title: COMPATIBLE: Add optional display_name field to User schema
description: Adds an optional 'display_name' property to the User response schema. Existing consumers ignore unknown fields (standard REST practice) — no breakage.

title: COMPATIBLE: Add new GET /api/v2/users/search endpoint
description: Adds a new search endpoint. No existing consumer depends on this endpoint — purely additive change with zero impact on registered consumers.

title: UNCERTAIN: Rename status enum values (active→enabled, inactive→disabled)
description: Changes status enum from [active, inactive] to [enabled, disabled]. Whether this breaks consumers depends on whether they compare against literal string values. LLM should flag UNCERTAIN with low-to-medium confidence.
